changes.from: **Our fall 2026 groups.** Seven groups across three classes each have their own flower name, so children have a name for their own group.

changes.from: **The studio rotation, 2022.** The studio day held an arrival, a first group, a second group later in the morning, a break, time in the piazza, setup and a third group in the early afternoon. North class came on Monday and Friday and Wednesday afternoon, West class on Wednesday morning only, and South class on Tuesday and Thursday.
changes.to: **A studio day.** A studio day can hold an arrival, a first group, a second group later in the morning, a break, time in the piazza, setup and a third group in the early afternoon, with each class coming on its own days.
